preconditions.description: The input integer n must satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= 10**9 for a in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each integer in the sequence a₂, a₃, ..., aₙ must satisfy 1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ 10⁹.
The input must contain exactly n-1 integers after the first line (n).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(result(i, a)) for i in range(1, n))
postconditions.description: For each i from 1 to n-1, the i-th line of stdout must be the final value of y when the program runs on the sequence [i, a₂, a₃, ..., aₙ], or -1 if the program does not terminate. The function result(i, a) computes this value as follows:

postconditions.expression: all('\n'.join(map(str, [result(i, a) for i in range(1, n)])) == '\n'.join(map(str, [y_final(i, a) for i in range(1, n)]))
postconditions.description: For each i, y_final(i, a) is the final value of y if the program terminates, otherwise -1. The program terminates if and only if there exists a finite sequence of steps 2 and 3 such that x ≤ 0 or x > n after some step. The final y is computed by simulating the program's steps until termination or detecting non-termination.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 10**18 or int(line) == -1 for line in stdout.split('\n') if line)
postconditions.description: Each output line must be either -1 (non-termination) or a non-negative integer ≤ 10¹⁸ (final y value).
